d:
An ancient scroll, a series of mysterious riddles and the possibility of a hidden fortune! Josh Gates investigates the Copper Scroll, one of the most intriguing Dead Sea Scrolls, to uncover whether its inscriptions could lead to a long-lost treasure. Following new clues, Josh takes his search from the ancient sites of Israel into the harsh Jordanian desert, where the trail leads to more questions about the riches described in the scroll. Could this centuries-old mystery finally reveal where the treasure lies?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 7, Episode 2, on Discovery Channel India.
